# Review return: two native parametric builds

- `3c01bf0d6576` source version 3.0.0 / rule `3722dcd853de`: canonical generator unchanged; added a full native transform-then-select family.
- Its new setting recolors the row-major-first component only after the demonstrated transform; a protected wrong-order Racket rule changes the selected component.
- `397767b9f88c` source version 3.1.0 / rule `b36e2b403189`: repaired the retained six-transform teaching hole by requiring diagonal-reflection evidence in every ordinary scene and lesson gate.
- Its new setting builds the D4 equality matrix, then retains every largest equivalence block; a protected wrong-order Racket rule selects by input-object area and changes the answer.
- Fresh changed-scope tests: 27/27 and 20/20 passed.
- Fresh authoring preflights: both passed with protected Racket; 48 and 40 label evaluations respectively.
- Fresh causal replays: both passed, two protected evaluations per target.
- Saved public projections: 16 one-query views per target; first-turn/private-metadata invariance checks passed.
- Bounded author self-review: seeds 0..31, 18 total named rival families, no surviving rival in the declared minimum demonstrations.
- Maximum-size checks include 30x30 inputs with 89 and 80 nonzero cells respectively, all-quadrant content, and boundary contacts.
- Canonical Racket defaults are byte-identical; no canonical data or approval flags changed.
- Routine for owner replay; exact-source owner acceptance and training admission remain pending. Final review was author-side because no independent reviewer/subagent tool was available.

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The complete square D4-equivalence matrix, before any class-block selection or recoloring.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Extract color-blind objects in top-left order and compute the complete D4-equivalence matrix with 2 for matching pairs and 0 otherwise.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Find four-connected nonzero components in the equivalence matrix, retain every component tied for greatest area, recolor retained cells to 8, and zero every other cell.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Component areas in Step B encode equivalence-class population only after Step A constructs the relation matrix. Selecting largest input objects first instead follows object cell area and can preserve a different singleton class.
